notes: Kratos DEM continuum (SphericContinuumParticle3D, explicit symplectic Euler, dt=3.02e-06 s = 0.12 x critical estimate); each chunk = cubic pack of spheres (spacing 0.05 m, radius 0.025 m) bonded by stiff unbreakable bonds (brick_stiffness_ratio 5)

mortar joints: DEM_parallel_bond_bilinear_damage_Linear on every particle bond crossing a scene bond; per joint area: tension cutoff f_t, Mohr-Coulomb tau0=c plus mu*sigma, linear softening with G_f (tension/shear), coupled damage; chunk-centre-to-centre normal/shear compliance equals the scene bond's kn/ks (joint bond in series with brick bonds)

unbonded contacts: DEM_D_Linear_classic, E = chunk material E, friction = joint (cracked) or min chunk friction, restitution 0.2 (not in the scene; same as the reference solver's contact constant); impactor: one rigid-sized sphere, mass from the scene, friction min(impactor, brick)
gravity settling 3311 steps (0.01 s) with the impactor held; kinetic energy after settling 5.685e-06 J; t=0 = impactor release
joint intact = at least one particle bond across it never failed; 158 joints partially cracked at end_time
